Class PathResourceResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.AbstractResourceResolver
org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.PathResourceResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResourceResolver
public class PathResourceResolver extends AbstractResourceResolver
A simple ResourceResolver that tries to find a resource under the given locations matching to the request path.

此解析器不会委托给 `ResourceResolverChain`》，并且预期在解析器链的末尾进行配置。

Since:
4.1
Author:
Jeremy Grelle, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sam Brannen

  • Method Details

    • setAllowedLocations

      public void setAllowedLocations(Resource @Nullable ... locations)
      By default, when a Resource is found, the path of the resolved resource is compared to ensure it's under the input location where it was found. However sometimes that may not be the case, for example, when CssLinkResourceTransformer resolves public URLs of links it contains, the CSS file is the location and the resources being resolved are css files, images, fonts and others located in adjacent or parent directories.

      此属性允许配置一个完整的位置列表，资源必须位于这些位置之下；这样，如果资源未位于其被发现时的相对位置下，也可以检查此列表。

      默认情况下，ResourceHttpRequestHandler 会将此属性初始化为与其位置列表相匹配。

      Parameters:
      locations - 允许的位置列表
      Since:
      4.1.2
      See Also:
      • ResourceHttpRequestHandler.initAllowedLocations()

      public void setLocationCharsets(Map<Resource,Charset> locationCharsets)
      Configure charsets associated with locations. If a static resource is found under a URL resource location the charset is used to encode the relative path

      注意： 仅在同时配置了urlPathHelper属性且其urlDecode属性设置为 true 时，才会使用 charset。

      Since:

    • getResource

      protected @Nullable Resource getResource(String resourcePath, Resource location) throws IOException
      Find the resource under the given location.

      默认实现会检查相对于该位置是否存在可读的 `Resource`。

      Parameters:
      resourcePath - 资源的路径
      location - 要检查的位置
      Returns:
      该资源，或如果未找到则为null
      Throws:
      IOException

    • checkResource

      protected boolean checkResource(Resource resource, Resource location) throws IOException
      对已解析的资源执行额外的检查，而不仅仅是检查资源是否存在且可读。默认实现还会验证该资源是位于其被发现时的相对位置之下，或是位于一个或多个允许的位置之下。
      Parameters:
      resource - 要检查的资源
      location - 找到该资源时相对于的位置
      Returns:
      如果资源位于有效位置，则为"true"；否则为"false"。
      Throws:
      IOException
      Since:
      4.1.2
